'''Kilmo''' was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> member of an [[alien]] [[Kilmo's species|species]]<ref name="Solo Adaptation 1" /> active in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' that take place on [[Corellia]] to six years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Corellia in ''Solo'' must take place in [[13 BBY]]. As the film shows Solo with the bruising Kilmo caused, the criminals must have encountered each other shortly beforehand.</ref> Kilmo encountered fellow criminal [[Han Solo]] and left him with bruising beneath his left [[eye]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kilmo was first identified in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> Although he was stated to be [[human]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' by [[Mur Lafferty]],<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> when he later appeared in the [[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 1|first issue]] of the [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] comic [[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation|adaptation]] of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', Kilmo was depicted as an [[alien]].<ref name="Solo Adaptation 1" />
